title: AutoRFP.ai Review 2026: Features, Pros and Cons, and Ratings
summary: A detailed AutoRFP.ai review: a deep look at its features, real pros and cons, G2 and Gartner Peer Insights ratings, user reviews, pricing at a glance, and alternatives.
body_markdown:
**AutoRFP.ai is an AI RFP software for drafting RFP, DDQ, and security questionnaire responses, built for small and growing bid teams.** It drafts each response from your own content, scores how confident it is, and runs review and approval in one place. This review covers what each feature does, the real pros and cons from user reviews, how it is rated, what it costs at a glance, and the alternatives worth testing beside it.


We do not cover pricing in this blog. For details on pricing, visit our detailed[AutoRFP pricing](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/autorfp-pricing) guide


## **AutoRFP.ai at a glance**


• It drafts a response to every question from your approved content, uploaded documents, and connected tools, and puts a Trust Score on each one so reviewers check only what looks uncertain.
• It charges per project, not per seat, so unlimited users cost nothing extra, and the bill tracks volume rather than headcount.
• Pricing is public and starts at $899 a month on the Scale plan (24 projects a year), billed yearly, with implementation, training, and support included on every tier.
• It rates 4.8 out of 5 on both Gartner Peer Insights (21 ratings) and G2 (61 reviews), where users praise drafting that turns a messy spreadsheet of questions into accurate first responses.
• The main limitations: the interface takes learning, and the content library needs an owner to stay accurate.


## **What AutoRFP.ai does and how it drafts responses**


AutoRFP.ai reads an incoming RFP or questionnaire, drafts a response to each question, and marks how confident it is so reviewers know what to check. Your team then assigns questions, edits, and approves in one workspace, and exports in the format the buyer asked for. The tool is built for response work, so the whole job from import to export sits in one place.


The drafting is the part that matters most.[Gartner predicts](https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2023-10-24-genai-sales-technologies-to-drive-efficiencies-in-prospecting-and-customer-meeting-prep-for-b2b-sales-oorganizations) that by 2026, sales teams using generative AI for proposal and bid responses will spend about 16 hours per RFP, down 40% from 27 hours, without losing win rate. AutoRFP.ai is built to close that gap, so the real test is how good the first draft is and how much editing it needs.


## **AutoRFP.ai features and how they help**


AutoRFP.ai handles drafting, scoring, library, collaboration, integrations, and security. Here is what each does and where it matters.


### **AI response drafting**


AutoRFP.ai splits an incoming RFP into questions and drafts a response to each. It draws on more than your past answers: your managed library, documents you upload (Word, Excel, PDF, CSV), a web page you add by URL, and connected tools like SharePoint, Confluence, and Google Drive. Every draft shows its source, so you can see where an answer came from. The work shifts from writing to checking, and reviewers describe it as turning a messy spreadsheet of questions into accurate first responses in one pass.


*Read our guide on*[How to Use AI for RFP Responses to Win More Deals](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/blog-posts-ai-in-the-rfp-process-2025)


### **Trust Scores**


Each response carries a confidence score tied to the content it came from. Reviewers go straight to the low-confidence answers and leave the rest, instead of re-reading every line. On a long questionnaire, that is the difference between a quick check and a full manual review, and it tells a manager how much of a draft is safe to send.


### **Content library and reuse**


Approved responses sit in a central library and are reused across[RFPs](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/what-is-a-request-for-proposal-rfp) ,[DDQs](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/ddq-meaning) , and questionnaires, so repeat questions are not rewritten. Reviewers call out fast search across a large library as a strength. The catch is upkeep: the library only stays accurate if someone keeps entries current and retires the ones that no longer apply.


### **Conflict and duplicate detection**


AutoRFP.ai flags responses that duplicate or clash with existing library content, but it does not detect when an answer has simply gone out of date, so keeping entries current is still a manual job. This matters most when your product, pricing, or policy details change often, where stale answers are the real accuracy risk.


### **Collaboration and review workflow**


You can assign questions to owners, approvers, and subject-matter experts, and keep comments and sign-off in one workspace instead of email. On a big bid with many contributors, that structure is the point, and reviewers name it as a reason the work stays on track to a deadline.


### **Integrations and single sign-on**


AutoRFP.ai offers 18 or more integrations, including Google Workspace and Microsoft, with single sign-on through both. Some reviewers want deeper Microsoft support and more output formats, such as PowerPoint proposals, so confirm your specific integrations and export needs during a trial.


### **Security and compliance**


AutoRFP.ai is ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 compliant, the two certifications most enterprise security reviews ask for. If your team answers security questionnaires too, having these in place shortens your own due diligence answers.


***If security questionnaires are part of your sales process, see***[How to Handle Security Questionnaires Without Slowing Deals .](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/vendor-assessment-questionnaire) ******


### **Onboarding and support**


Implementation, online training, and unlimited support come with every plan, not as a separate services tier. Reviewers describe support and technical account management as responsive. They also note a real learning curve at the start, and training is what shortens it.


*Read more:*[15 Best RFP Software and Tools in 2026: Ranked and Reviewed](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/best-rfp-software)


## **AutoRFP.ai ratings, pros, and cons**


AutoRFP.ai rates 4.8/5 on both[Gartner Peer Insights](https://www.gartner.com/reviews/product/autorfp-ai?marketSeoName=rfp-response-management-applications) (21 ratings) and[G2](https://www.g2.com/products/inventive-ai/reviews) (61 reviews, the larger sample). The pros and cons below, drawn from real G2 review sentiment, tell you more than the average score does. Weigh them against how your team works.


Pros Cons


Auto-fills a large share of the first draft, with reviewers citing around 90% of a first draft and up to 75% less processing time. Reviewers call the interface non-intuitive and at times “janky,” and say it is hard to get back to where you left off.


Shows the exact source document behind each answer, so reviewers can verify quickly. Extraction from free-text PDFs like SOPs and policies is weak, and answers can come out wordy or repetitive across questions.


Trust and completeness scoring flags which answers need a check and whether every part of a question is covered. Answers go stale when your products change often, so the library still needs active upkeep.


Turns messy Excel questionnaires into populated answers and exports in the buyer’s original format. Change tracking is thin: contributor edits and answer history are hard to see or roll back.


Built-in AI editing adjusts tone and trims answers to character or word limits. Search, sort, and filtering of past RFPs is limited, and filters can behave unexpectedly.


Assignment, sequential approval, and Slack and Teams access keep cross-team work moving, backed by responsive support. Output gaps remain (no PowerPoint or written-proposal generation, limited reporting), and it is web-only, with lag on Safari and no dark mode.


## **What AutoRFP.ai users say on G2 and Gartner**


A few reviews on G2 show the pattern behind the score: strong time savings and search, with notes on ramp-up and library upkeep. Reviewer names and roles are shown as published on G2 and Gartner.


***An anonymous Gartner Peer Insights reviewer***[(4.0/5, December 2025)](https://www.gartner.com/reviews/market/rfp-response-management-applications/vendor/autorfp-ai/product/autorfp-ai/review/view/6568064) ***-***


Found the tool very valuable and said it ticks a lot of boxes for managing RFPs, particularly the ability to track and project-manage each team’s progress, **but wanted a way to export specific SME questions separately from the full project and wished that content added mid-project was pulled into one project instead of separate files.**


A verified user in insurance at a small business[(5/5, April 2025](https://www.g2.com/products/autorfp-ai/reviews/autorfp-ai-review-11009183) ) saved over six hours on a single RFP and expects it to be worth every penny as their volume grows, though **they noted that unused credits do not roll over within the calendar year.**


Kristi C., a Marketing and Communications Specialist at a mid-market company[(5/5, January 2025)](https://www.g2.com/products/autorfp-ai/reviews/autorfp-ai-review-10788117) , said the fields populate so quickly when you process a document that she no longer hunts through old proposals for the right answer, **but felt it gives repetitive answers across different questions, something she expects to improve as the AI learns her team’s needs.**


Chris D., a CTO at a small business ([5/5, February 2025)](https://www.g2.com/products/autorfp-ai/reviews/autorfp-ai-review-10855090) , said AutoRFP solves the blank-page problem and removes the overhead of heavy library management by using context clues like recency, and while he **found parts of the interface a little rough** , those issues never blocked his team’s work.

## **Who AutoRFP.ai is the right fit for (and who should look elsewhere)**


AutoRFP.ai is best for teams with steady, repeatable RFP volume and someone to keep the content library current. It is a weaker fit if your volume swings, you need tight formatting control, or you want to be productive in days. Test it on your own live RFPs first, because[Gartner](https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2022-07-12-gartner-finds-that-majority-of-technology-purchases-come-with-high-degree-of-regret) found that 56% of companies regret their biggest technology purchase, usually from signing before checking the fit.


**Best fit if you:**


- Run a small or mid-sized proposal or sales team with steady volume
- Want confidence scores and fast cross-team review
- Are fine with a web-only tool and will invest in the ramp-up


**Look further if you:**


- Want responses that are accurate from the first draft, grounded in approved content, with missing information flagged rather than guessed
- Need control over templates and formatting, including branded PowerPoint and full written proposals, not just answers filled back into the questionnaire
- Want a tool the whole team can learn in days, with no prompt-writing or AI expertise required
- Expect your RFP volume to change through the year, or prefer to pay for what you use instead of a fixed block of projects

## Frequently Asked Questions


### What is AutoRFP.ai used for?


It drafts and manages responses to RFPs, DDQs, tenders, and security questionnaires. It writes first-draft responses from your content, scores each for confidence, and runs the assignment and review workflow in one place.


### Does AutoRFP.ai offer a free trial?


No standard free trial. It offers a 30-day money-back guarantee instead, which applies only if you complete set onboarding steps, such as importing past responses, inviting users, and exporting a project.


### How long does AutoRFP.ai take to set up?


Fast. AutoRFP.ai says most teams see their first AI-drafted responses within about 48 hours of ingesting past responses, and have a power user running a live RFP within the first week.


### Does AutoRFP.ai train its AI on your data?


No. Your content and responses are never used to train public AI models like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. Data is isolated per customer, encrypted at rest, and deleted on request.


### Where is AutoRFP.ai data stored?


You pick a hosting region, US (Oregon), EU (Frankfurt), or Australia (Sydney), and your data stays in that region, including during AI processing. The platform is ISO 27001:2022 certified and SOC 2 Type II audited.


### What are the best AutoRFP.ai alternatives?


The ones most often weighed against it are Inventive AI, Responsive, Loopio, and SiftHub. The right pick depends on whether you want AI-native drafting, a large managed library, or an enterprise module set, so test two or three on the same live RFP.
